summary: In-Editor AI assistant backed by OpenAI, Anthropic or Kimi (Moonshot) with locally stored API keys. Knows the engine docs and recent updates, can propose file edits (user saves always take priority), and includes a Gem Manager panel to enable and disable gems without the command line.
requirements: Enter an API key for at least one provider in the assistant's Settings tab. Keys are stored per-user outside the project and are never committed.
